pa.cau: He did not eat his pho today.

cau.vi: T'i cቃn nቃm nghኃ ch't vቃ lቁi bቃt ᄑቃu ᄑau ᄑቇu rናi.

pa.cau: I need to lie down because my headache is coming back.

cau.en: Does your stomachache feel better after drinking that warm water?

pa.cau: Does your stomachache feel better after drinking that warm water?

cau.vi: Linh bቃ ᄑau hናng n'n c' ቃy kh'ng thኃ n'i chuyቇn ᄑiቇn thoቁi ᄑăቃc.

pa.cau: Linh has a sore throat, so she cannot talk on the phone.

cau.vi: Con g!i chኃ bቃ sኑt cao ᄑቃy, chኃ n'n ᄑăa ch!u vቃ nhቁ ᄑi.

pa.cau: Your daughter has a high fever, so you should take her home.

cau.vi: Bኑ t'i bቃ ho nቃng nhăng 'ng ቃy cና kh'ng chቃu ᄑi kh!m.

pa.cau: My father has a bad cough, but he refuses to see a doctor.
pa.ipa_noi: /maɪ ˈfɑːðə həz‿ə bæd kɒf bət‿i rəˈfjuːzəz tə siː ə ˈdɒktə/

pa.cau: Don't go to the office if you still have the flu, Tuan.

pa.cau: My arm is very painful after getting the flu vaccine yesterday.

cau.en: Did you take the medicine that the doctor gave you, Lan?

pa.cau: Did you take the medicine that the doctor gave you, Lan?

pa.cau: We need to go to the hospital to get a new prescription.

cau.en: I have to cancel my appointment with the dentist this afternoon.
cau.vi: T'i phኃi hናy cuኙc hቁn vናi nha sቃ chiቇu nay rናi.

cau.en: Are there any other symptoms that you did not tell me about?
cau.vi: C'n triቇu chናng nቁo kh!c mቁ bቁn chāa n'i vናi t'i kh'ng?

pa.cau: Are there any other symptoms that you did not tell me about?

cau.en: Minh needs at least a week to recover from his motorbike accident.
cau.vi: Minh cቃn ቃt nhቁt mኙt tuቇn ᄑኃ hናi phኗc sau vኗ tai nቁn xe m!y.

pa.cau: Minh needs at least a week to recover from his motorbike accident.
pa.ipa_noi: /mɪn niːdz‿ət liːst‿ə lɑːst naɪt tə rɪˈkʌvə frəm hɪz ˈməʊtəˌbaɪk ˈæksədənt/

cau.en: You should rest this weekend instead of working on that report.
cau.vi: Cuኑi tuቇn nቁy bቁn n'n nghኃ ngăi thay vቃ lቁm c!i b!o c!o ᄑ!o.

pa.cau: You should rest this weekend instead of working on that report.
pa.ipa_noi: /jə ʃəd rest ðɪs ˌwiːkˈend ˌɪnˈsted‿əv ˈwɜːkɪŋ ɒn ðət riːˈpɔːt/

cau.en: My grandmother does some light exercise in the park every morning.
cau.vi: Bቁ t'i tቃp thኃ dኗc nhቃ nhቁng ቃ c'ng vi'n mኗi s!ng.

pa.cau: My grandmother does some light exercise in the park every morning.

pa.cau: What's the matter with Nam?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌts ðə ˈmætə wɪð næm/

pa.cau: He looks so tired today.

pa.cau: If your cough gets worse, you should see a doctor immediately.

cau.en: You shouldn't drink iced tea when your throat is painful.
cau.vi: Bቁn kh'ng n'n uኑng trቁ ᄑ! khi cና hናng ᄑang bቃ ᄑau.

pa.cau: You shouldn't drink iced tea when your throat is painful.

cau.vi: Sao bቁn kh'ng xin nghኃ mኙt ngቁy ᄑኃ ᄑi kh!m b!c sቃ nhኃ?

pa.cau: Why don't you take a day off to visit the doctor?
pa.ipa_noi: /waɪ dəʊn‿tʃə teɪk‿ə deɪ ɒf tə ˈvɪzɪt ðə ˈdɒktə/

cau.vi: Tኑt nhቁt lቁ cቃu n'n vቁ nhቁ ngና ᄑi vቃ tr'ng cቃu nhቃt nhቁt lቁm.

pa.cau: You'd better go home and sleep because you look very pale.
pa.ipa_noi: /juːd ˈbetə ɡəʊ həʊm‿ən sliːp bɪˈkɔːz‿jə lʊk ˈveri peɪl/

cau.en: I'd like to make an appointment with the doctor for tomorrow.
cau.vi: T'i muኑn ᄑቁt lቃch hቁn vናi b!c sቃ vቁo ngቁy mai.

pa.cau: I'd like to make an appointment with the doctor for tomorrow.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪd laɪk tə meɪk‿ən‿əˈpɔɪntmənt‿wɪð ðə ˈdɒktə fə təˈdeɪ/

cau.en: My stomachache started right after I ate that spicy com tam.
cau.vi: Bኗng t'i bቃt ᄑቃu ᄑau ngay sau khi ăn ᄑቃa căm tቁm cay ᄑ!o.

pa.cau: My stomachache started right after I ate that spicy com tam.
pa.ipa_noi: /maɪ ˈstʌməkeɪk ˈstɑːtɪd tɜːn left ˈɑːftə aɪ eɪt ðət ˈspaɪsi kɒm tæm/

cau.vi: Thuኑc nቁy ᄑቁt lቁm, gi! hān năm trăm nghቃn ᄑናng cā.

cau.en: Is it healthy to eat banh mi for breakfast every day?
cau.vi: Ăn b!nh mቃ vቁo bናa s!ng mኗi ngቁy thቃ c' tኑt cho sናc khናe kh'ng?

pa.cau: Is it healthy to eat banh mi for breakfast every day?
